name: 海洋2002
group_note: Evolved/later sibling of hy2000 (10630/10632 of hy2000's files shared by path; hy2002 is a superset with ~3000 additional files) -- same ES2/jinyong-lineage 海洋II (Ocean II) codebase. Bugs fixed, several proactively applied from the known hy2000 fix set and confirmed present here too: (1) stale MASTER_OB/SIMUL_EFUN_OB macros pointed at /adm/single/ dead-code duplicates (§7.56-class); (2) §7.54-class sscanf(read_file(missing_file)) crashes in logind.lpc's howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() and uptime.lpc's LASTCRASH display; (3) §7.52-class socket gutting in adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/the socket_close() line in send_shutdown() -- CRITICAL here because DNS_MASTER->query_muds()/query_svc() are called mid-flow in logind.lpc's gb_big5(), so the daemon failing silently aborted the rest of gb_big5() including the final id-prompt write(), blocking registration entirely with zero visible error; (4) classic §8.1 check_legal_name() byte-doubled bounds (4/10 chars -> 2/5) plus the i%2==0 gate and name[i..<0] tail-slice in logind.lpc (is_chinese() itself was already correct). Both GB and BIG5 encoding menu choices confirmed working live, no fix needed. Admin bootstrap deviates from the usual wizlist pattern AND from hy2000's: securd.lpc hardcodes bootstrap admin id 'hxsd' directly in restore_list(), but that id is ALREADY an existing archived player account with an unknown password (new AGENTS.md §1.5 bug class) -- added a parallel set("wiz_status/fluffos","(admin)") line, registered fluffos/Mud@2026Pass1 normally, confirmed via visible 目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name. Formatter run found 2 genuinely corrupted files (cmds/usr/setbak.lpc heredoc help text, and help/help/menpai.lpc a plaintext help-content file collapsed to one line with every character respaced) -- both reverted via git checkout. Note a real 60-second same-IP anti-abuse rate limit between new-character registrations (§10.1-class intentional design, not a bug).
